author: nickyeow

english.text: Never did I dream that George would cheat me.

text: 我連發夢都無諗過阿 George 會呃我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why do bees die after stinging?

author: nickyeow

english.text: By the way, I have something to tell you.

english.text: Be yourself.

author: kaenif

english.text: That guy is batshit crazy.

jyutping: tiu4 jau2 dou1 ci1 gaau1 faa1 ge3。

english.text: Why are you looking so sad?

jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 hou2 ci5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1 gam2 ge3？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It looks like they're satisfied with the result.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hou2 ci5 deoi3 go3 git3 gwo2 hou2 mun5 ji3 gam2。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My father has been busy.

jyutping: ngo5 lou5 dau6 ni1 paai4 hou2 mong4。

english.text: I'm not interested in the tea ceremony or flower arranging.

english.text: Let's put up the Christmas tree there.

jyutping: jat1 jyu1 baai2 po1 sing3 daan3 syu6 hai2 go2 dou3 laa1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want to speak to your manager.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 gin3 nei5 dei6 ging1 lei5。
text: 我想見你哋經理。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That all happened in just three days.

jyutping: ne1 jat1 cai3 jat1 cai3 dou1 hai2 saam1 jat6 zi1 noi6 faat3 sang1。
text: 呢一切一切都喺三日之內發生。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You never arrive on time.

jyutping: nei5 mou5 jat1 ci3 hai6 zeon2 si4 ge3。

english.text: Sami was sitting and reading a book all by himself.

jyutping: nei5 hai2 ce1 zaam6 gin3 m4 gin3 aa3 tong1 aa1？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: We're trying a new approach this year.

english.text: Physicists who will conduct experiments at the Large Hadron Collider are generally focused on pure research, not practical applications. But as in the past, there are likely to be important spin-offs. Previous discoveries from fundamental science have led to indispensable tools in medicine, industry and research. And then, of course, the World Wide Web was invented at CERN. It was a spin-off from CERN's large research program in information technology.

text: 會喺大型強子對撞機進行實驗嘅物理學家通常都係專注於純粹嘅研究，而唔係實際應用。但同過去一樣，以前嘅基礎科學發現已經導致咗醫學上不可或缺嘅工具、工業同研究，然後，萬維網係喺歐洲核子研究中心發明嘅。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Jai, an East Indian of Hindu family background, was a close friend to me when I was living in Vancouver, BC. He, his German wife Erika, and two daughters lived in a nice condominium in the Kitsilano beach area of Vancouver, BC. He was initially my coworker in a software company. He liked his job, as it was full of learning. His family followed a European-style of living in North America, as they were unhindered by television, took mass transit, ate German food, and immersed themselves in the EU languages of English, German, and French. Jai and Erika wanted to take Japanese in night school, but thought that it might be too challenging. Jai liked the ideas of Zen Buddhism.

jyutping: Jai hai6 jat1 go3 jau5 jan3 dou6 gaau3 gaa1 ting4 bui3 ging2 ge3 dung1 jan3 dou6 jan4，dong1 ngo5 zyu6 hai2 BC wan1 go1 waa4 go2 zan6，keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 hou2 pang4 jau5。keoi5 tung4 keoi5 ge3 dak1 gwok3 lou5 po4 Erika tung4 loeng5 go3 neoi5 zyu6 hai2 BC wan1 go1 waa4 ge3 Kitsilano hoi2 taan1 keoi1 ge3 jat1 gaan1 hou2 leng3 ge3 gung1 jyu6。keoi5 zeoi3 co1 hai6 ngo5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 jyun5 gin2 gung1 si1 ge3 tung4 si6。keoi5 zung1 ji3 keoi5 fan6 gung1，jan1 wai6 keoi5 cung1 mun5 hok6 zaap6。keoi5 ge3 gaa1 jan4 hai2 bak1 mei5 gan1 ceoi4 au1 zau1 sik1 ge3 sang1 wut6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 sau6 din6 si6 ge3 zo2 ngoi6，daap3 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 gung1 geoi6，sik6 dak1 gwok3 sik6 mat6，tung4 maai4 cam4 zam3 hai2 au1 mang4 ge3 jing1 man2、dak1 man2 tung4 faat3 man2 jyu5 jin4 jap6 min6。 Jai tung4 Erika soeng2 hai2 je6 haau6 hok6 jat6 man2，daan6 hai6 gok3 dak1 ho2 nang4 taai3 gwo3 tiu1 zin3。 Jai hou2 zung1 ji3 sim4 zung1 ge3 si1 soeng2。
text: Jai 係一個有印度教家庭背景嘅東印度人，當我住喺 BC 溫哥華嗰陣，佢係我嘅好朋友。佢同佢嘅德國老婆 Erika 同兩個女住喺 BC 溫哥華嘅 Kitsilano 海灘區嘅一間好靚嘅公寓。佢最初係我喺一間軟件公司嘅同事。佢鍾意佢份工，因為佢充滿學習。佢嘅家人喺北美跟隨歐洲式嘅生活，因為佢哋唔受電視嘅阻礙，搭公共交通工具，食德國食物，同埋沉浸喺歐盟嘅英文、德文同法文語言入面。 Jai 同 Erika 想喺夜校學日文，但係覺得可能太過挑戰。 Jai 好鍾意禪宗嘅思想。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: After ten o'clock in the morning on the 4th of March of 2022, on Lulu Island, on my way to the pizzeria, I took the long route through the school playground and field, and I sat in the little gazebo, as I gazed at the grey-sky vista. After lunchtime, sunny then, I went to the cafe for iced black tea. There were old Russian men, perhaps with a bit of Hun or other Mongoloid ancestry. A handsome medium-height dark-haired bearded man in army-green pants was waiting in line. Like engraved or sculpted through his light sweater in light grey were his nipples and tight muscles. At my table, a brown student seated himself to eat a black box of sushi with chopsticks and drink a red can of black cola. There were many multiracial students standing around.

text: 2022 年 3 月 4 號朝早十點幾，喺露露島，喺去薄餅店嘅路上，我行咗條好長嘅路線，經過學校嘅操場同田野，然後我坐喺小涼亭度，望住灰色嘅天空。午餐時間之後，晴朗嘅時候，我去咗間咖啡館飲冰黑茶，或者同埋其他俄羅斯人一齊飲。一個着住軍綠色褲嘅中等身高黑髮靚仔嘅男人排隊等緊佢嘅乳頭同緊繃嘅肌肉，佢嘅乳頭同緊緻嘅肌肉好似刻喺佢淺灰色嘅毛衣入面噉。喺我張枱度，有個啡色嘅學生坐低，用對筷子食緊一盒黑色嘅壽司，同埋飲緊一罐紅色嘅黑可樂。周圍企咗好多多種族嘅學生。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The history of American residential architecture has always been kind of like an all-you-can-eat buffet," says architect Susan Piedmont-Palladino, director of Virginia Tech's Washington Alexandria Architecture Center. "We can borrow anybody's style of architecture and I'm not sure that's the attitude in other countries around the world. I also think we're dominated by the single family house in a way that other places aren't."

text: 弗吉尼亞理工大學華盛頓亞歷山大建築中心主任建築師蘇珊 · 皮埃蒙特 · 帕拉迪諾話：「美國住宅建築嘅歷史一直都好似一個自助餐噉。」「我哋可以借用任何人嘅建築風格，但我唔肯定世界其他國家嘅態度係咁。我亦都覺得我哋係由單戶住宅主導，而其他地方就冇。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Their sports were of a childish, pastoral character; Chloe would neglect her flock to roam in search of day-lilies, the stalks of which she twisted into traps for locusts; while Daphnis often played from morn till eve upon a pipe, which he had formed of slender reeds, perforating them between their joints, and securing them together with soft wax.

text: 佢哋嘅運動係一種童真、牧養嘅性質； Chloe 會忽略佢嘅羊群去漫步尋找黃花菜，佢將黃花菜嘅莖扭成蝗蟲嘅陷阱；而達夫尼斯就成日由朝早到晚喺一條管上面玩，佢係用細長嘅芦苇整成嘅，喺佢哋嘅關節之間穿孔，然後用軟蠟將佢哋固定埋一齊。
